title: Foundation
unlocks: You can start building. Not employable yet.

items.text: Write Python functions, classes, and OOP without looking things up
Handle exceptions, read and write files, and work with JSON
Use Git daily: commit, branch, merge, resolve a conflict, push to GitHub
Be comfortable in the terminal (navigate, run scripts, read logs)
Explain how HTTP works: methods, status codes, headers, request and response
